Very average to say the least
Mar 2020 • Couples
We visited here both on a morning for breakfast and on an evening for food and drinks, as we were staying in the Mui Ne Budget Hotel.
Most of the reps aren’t very welcoming at all and the way we heard some of them speaking to other guests (although not us) was a bit patronising.
The breakfast was bang average. I ordered the ‘Combo 2’ for 100,000 VND which consisted of bread, bacon, egg etc and also came with a side portion of fruit, which was a bit old and dry. The juice it comes with is so watery too.
However the evening food was actually delicious. I ordered the vegetable fried rice which was very tasty and reasonably priced.
On a night time there is loud music pumping and drinking games. If you like that sort of thing you’ll appreciate it, but for us we had the sunrise sand dunes tour the next day so we weren’t up to it.
There is a pool here to relax during the day and there is free WiFi which works ok.
Overall this place is ok but don’t expect to be blown away.

Nice visit, ok food
Jul 2019 • Family
First - this is a backpacker hotel and restaurant - and not a regular restaurant. I would say not suitable for smaller kids, due to high possibility of parties. The prices are extremely low, we ate 9 persons (5 children) with coctails, wine, starters, mains and desserts for 2.400’ VND. 
The food was good, but nothing special. The menu had something for every taste, but none of it was made to perfection. The drinks were very light/waterish. Great for a savers budget but not quite what we expected. 
We also experienced a power break and that the credit card machine was out of order. 
All in all an interesting experience but not a place to return.

Written July 15, 2019
Mui Ne Hills Hotels
Dear Tonelone,

First of all thank you for having visited our restaurant with your friends and family. I personally took your order and also followed up afterwards where you mentioned you were very satisfied with the food. It would have been nice to hear any issues - if any - during your visit, which would have allowed us to verify and if necessary, correct.

However we need to make a few corrections to your review :

1/ Breeze is located inside Mui Ne Hills Bliss Hotel which is NOT a backpacker hotel, on the contrary.

2/ The restaurant is open for everyone, same as yourself who did not stay in any of our hotels or hostels.

3/ Due to our extremely low price setting (as you correctly reported) we indeed are extremely busy every night and get lots of guests staying in our next door Mui Ne Hills Backpackers hostel, where - obviously - a lot of backpackers are staying.

4/ In Breeze there are NO parties. We play chill or lounge music from early morning till late night.

5/ After closing time of 10 PM , indeed next door every night we have a party starting in our (separate) Mad Monkey Backpackers bar, with full entertainment program and late night DJ's. Nothing of these activities however disturbs the vibe in our Breeze Restaurant. 

6/ Breeze is very often frequented by families with young children who enjoy the quiet atmosphere and/ or the various swimming pools.

7/ Any cocktail is made with proper alcohol and measured with shotglasses of 5cl. If you wished to have your drinks stronger we would advise you to order double shots.

8/ The power break which occurred during your visit was a general power cut which affected the whole of Mui Ne and which lasted exactly 8 seconds. 

Thank you once again for having visited our venue.

Best regards
